note: Both sets correctly capture the 40W/9W/7W light-output equivalence, the T24 high-efficacy requirement for HARVEST HOME fixtures, and the vacancy-sensor bypass requirement with its conditional clause. However, both are padded with near-duplicate claims: Set A repeats the incandescent 40W and vacancy-sensor claims, while Set B repeats nearly every claim (incandescent, CFL, LED, T24 requirement, vacancy sensor), giving it 10 claims for only about 5 distinct facts. Neither set captures the LIGHTING LEVELS table values (3 FC, 5-10 FC, 30 FC, 50 FC and bulb counts) shown on the page, so that omission is shared. Set A is the leaner, less redundant version of essentially the same correct content.
